caption: The drawing features a detailed depiction of a wooden cabinet rendered primarily in shades of reddish-brown, suggesting a varnished or stained wood finish. The front view of the cabinet is fully colored and centrally positioned, showing two main sections: the upper section has two glass-paneled doors with a grid of wooden muntins, and the lower section contains drawers and solid panel doors arranged symmetrically. The upper section displays decorative carved elements at the midpoint of the vertical supports, while the top and bottom edges of the cabinet are accentuated with thicker molding. To the right of the main drawing, there is a side elevation in line art, outlining the profile of the cabinet, which shows a curving, protruding profile for the top molding and a stepped base. At the bottom left of the sheet is a small detail diagram with dimensions labeled "MEYEN," showing a precise cross-sectional profile of one of the cabinet’s moldings. At the bottom right, there is a small front elevation schematic in line art, showing the arrangement of panels and drawers on the cabinet's facade. The background is a plain, light beige, and the entire design is neatly bordered by thin, straight lines.
title: Bookcase and Writing Desk
